lessons.claim: For a commensurate hexagonal lattice the box aspect ratio **is not chosen; commensurability sets it**. L_x=n_x·a_NN, L_y=n_y·(√3/2)a_NN, N=n_x·n_y, with n_y even (the staggered rows have a period of 2 rows). A square L=a_mean√N gets only φ right and the lattice does not match at the seam, injecting defects. trap-drag has N~300 → 17×18=306 (aspect ratio 1.091; the alternatives were 15×20=300/0.866 and 16×18=288/1.026). ★ Take the drag direction along the nearest-neighbour (row) direction -- dragging perpendicular to the rows makes the spatial period 2 rows=√3 a_NN and reduces the number of periods in the same box from 17 to 10.
